use amigo_core::{AmigoError, AmigoResult};
use amigo_math::ColorRgba;
use amigo_runtime::Runtime;
use amigo_state::SceneStateService;

use crate::{
    UiModelBinding, UiModelBindingKind, UiModelBindingService, UiNode as RuntimeUiNode,
    UiSceneService, UiStateService, UiThemeService,
};

fn required<T: Send + Sync + 'static>(runtime: &Runtime) -> AmigoResult<std::sync::Arc<T>> {
    runtime.resolve::<T>().ok_or_else(|| {
        AmigoError::Message(format!(
            "required service `{}` is not registered",
            std::any::type_name::<T>()
        ))
    })
}

pub fn tick_ui_bindings(runtime: &Runtime) -> AmigoResult<()> {
    let ui_scene = required::<UiSceneService>(runtime)?;
    let ui_state = required::<UiStateService>(runtime)?;
    let ui_theme = runtime.resolve::<UiThemeService>();
    let ui_model_bindings = required::<UiModelBindingService>(runtime)?;
    let scene_state = required::<SceneStateService>(runtime)?;

    for command in ui_scene.commands() {
        let root_segment = command
            .document
            .root
            .id
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "root".to_owned());
        let root_path = format!("{}.{}", command.entity_name, root_segment);
        apply_node_binds(
            &command.document.root,
            &root_path,
            ui_state.as_ref(),
            scene_state.as_ref(),
        );
    }

    for binding in ui_model_bindings.bindings() {
        apply_model_binding(
            &binding,
            ui_state.as_ref(),
            ui_theme.as_deref(),
            scene_state.as_ref(),
        );
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn apply_model_binding(
    binding: &UiModelBinding,
    ui_state: &UiStateService,
    ui_theme: Option<&UiThemeService>,
    scene_state: &SceneStateService,
) {
    match binding.kind {
        UiModelBindingKind::Text => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state_value_as_text(scene_state, &binding.state_key) {
                let _ =
                    ui_state.set_text(&binding.path, format_text_value(&value, &binding.format));
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Value => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state_value_as_f32(scene_state, &binding.state_key) {
                let _ = ui_state.set_value(&binding.path, value);
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Height => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state_value_as_f32(scene_state, &binding.state_key) {
                let _ = ui_state.set_height(&binding.path, value);
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Visible => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_bool(&binding.state_key) {
                if value {
                    let _ = ui_state.show(&binding.path);
                } else {
                    let _ = ui_state.hide(&binding.path);
                }
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Enabled => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_bool(&binding.state_key) {
                if value {
                    let _ = ui_state.enable(&binding.path);
                } else {
                    let _ = ui_state.disable(&binding.path);
                }
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Selected => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_string(&binding.state_key) {
                let _ = ui_state.set_selected(&binding.path, value);
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Options => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_string(&binding.state_key) {
                let _ = ui_state.set_options(&binding.path, parse_options(&value));
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Color => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_string(&binding.state_key) {
                if let Some(color) = parse_color_rgba_hex(&value) {
                    let _ = ui_state.set_color(&binding.path, color);
                }
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Background => {
            if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_string(&binding.state_key) {
                if let Some(color) = parse_color_rgba_hex(&value) {
                    let _ = ui_state.set_background(&binding.path, color);
                }
            }
        }
        UiModelBindingKind::Theme => {
            if let (Some(ui_theme), Some(value)) =
                (ui_theme, scene_state.get_string(&binding.state_key))
            {
                let _ = ui_theme.set_active_theme(&value);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn apply_node_binds(
    node: &RuntimeUiNode,
    path: &str,
    ui_state: &UiStateService,
    scene_state: &SceneStateService,
) {
    if let Some(key) = node.binds.text.as_deref() {
        if let Some(value) = scene_state_value_as_text(scene_state, key) {
            let _ = ui_state.set_text(path, value);
        }
    }
    if let Some(key) = node.binds.value.as_deref() {
        if let Some(value) = scene_state_value_as_f32(scene_state, key) {
            let _ = ui_state.set_value(path, value);
        }
    }
    if let Some(key) = node.binds.visible.as_deref() {
        if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_bool(key) {
            if value {
                let _ = ui_state.show(path);
            } else {
                let _ = ui_state.hide(path);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(key) = node.binds.enabled.as_deref() {
        if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_bool(key) {
            if value {
                let _ = ui_state.enable(path);
            } else {
                let _ = ui_state.disable(path);
            }
        }
    }

    for (index, child) in node.children.iter().enumerate() {
        let segment = child
            .id
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}-{index}", child.kind.label()));
        let child_path = format!("{path}.{segment}");
        apply_node_binds(child, &child_path, ui_state, scene_state);
    }
}

fn scene_state_value_as_text(scene_state: &SceneStateService, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_string(key) {
        return Some(value);
    }
    if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_int(key) {
        return Some(value.to_string());
    }
    if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_float(key) {
        return Some(format_float(value));
    }
    scene_state.get_bool(key).map(|value| value.to_string())
}

fn scene_state_value_as_f32(scene_state: &SceneStateService, key: &str) -> Option<f32> {
    if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_float(key) {
        return Some(value as f32);
    }
    if let Some(value) = scene_state.get_int(key) {
        return Some(value as f32);
    }
    scene_state
        .get_bool(key)
        .map(|value| if value { 1.0 } else { 0.0 })
}

fn format_float(value: f64) -> String {
    let text = value.to_string();
    text.strip_suffix(".0").unwrap_or(&text).to_owned()
}

fn format_text_value(value: &str, format: &Option<String>) -> String {
    format
        .as_ref()
        .map(|format| format.replace("{value}", value))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| value.to_owned())
}

fn parse_options(value: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    value
        .split(['|', '\n'])
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter(|option| !option.is_empty())
        .map(str::to_owned)
        .collect()
}

fn parse_color_rgba_hex(value: &str) -> Option<ColorRgba> {
    let hex = value.strip_prefix('#').unwrap_or(value);
    let (r, g, b, a) = match hex.len() {
        6 => (
            parse_hex_channel(&hex[0..2])?,
            parse_hex_channel(&hex[2..4])?,
            parse_hex_channel(&hex[4..6])?,
            255,
        ),
        8 => (
            parse_hex_channel(&hex[0..2])?,
            parse_hex_channel(&hex[2..4])?,
            parse_hex_channel(&hex[4..6])?,
            parse_hex_channel(&hex[6..8])?,
        ),
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some(ColorRgba::new(
        r as f32 / 255.0,
        g as f32 / 255.0,
        b as f32 / 255.0,
        a as f32 / 255.0,
    ))
}

fn parse_hex_channel(value: &str) -> Option<u8> {
    u8::from_str_radix(value, 16).ok()
}

use crate::flow::layout_node;
use crate::measure::measure_element;
use crate::model::{LayoutElement, LayoutNode, LayoutRect, LayoutViewport, LayoutViewportScaling};
use crate::viewport::transform_layout_for_viewport;

pub fn compute_layout<T: Clone>(
    root_path: &str,
    viewport: LayoutViewport,
    root: &LayoutElement<T>,
    document_viewport: Option<(LayoutViewport, LayoutViewportScaling)>,
) -> LayoutNode<T> {
    let layout_viewport = match document_viewport {
        Some((vp, LayoutViewportScaling::Fixed | LayoutViewportScaling::Fit)) => {
            LayoutViewport::new(vp.width.max(1.0), vp.height.max(1.0))
        }
        _ => viewport,
    };

    let measured = measure_element(root);
    let width = root.style.width.unwrap_or(measured.0).max(0.0);
    let height = root.style.height.unwrap_or(measured.1).max(0.0);
    let x = resolve_screen_axis(
        root.style.left,
        root.style.right,
        layout_viewport.width,
        width,
    );
    let y = resolve_screen_axis(
        root.style.top,
        root.style.bottom,
        layout_viewport.height,
        height,
    );
    let root_rect = LayoutRect::new(x, y, width, height);
    let layout = layout_node(
        root_path,
        root,
        root_rect,
        root.id.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "root".to_owned()),
        0,
    );
    transform_layout_for_viewport(layout, viewport, document_viewport)
}

pub(crate) fn resolve_screen_axis(
    start: Option<f32>,
    end: Option<f32>,
    extent: f32,
    size: f32,
) -> f32 {
    match (start, end) {
        (Some(start), _) => start,
        (None, Some(end)) => (extent - end - size).max(0.0),
        (None, None) => 0.0,
    }
}

use crate::measure::{
    group_box_label_height, measure_element, selected_tab_id, tab_view_header_height,
};
use crate::model::{LayoutElement, LayoutKind, LayoutLeafKind, LayoutNode, LayoutRect};

pub(crate) fn layout_node<T: Clone>(
    parent_path: &str,
    node: &LayoutElement<T>,
    rect: LayoutRect,
    segment: String,
    depth_index: usize,
) -> LayoutNode<T> {
    let path = format!("{parent_path}.{segment}");
    let content = rect.inset(node.style.padding.max(0.0));
    let gap = node.style.gap.max(0.0);

    let children_rects = match &node.kind {
        LayoutKind::Row => layout_row_children(node, content, gap),
        LayoutKind::Stack => layout_stack_children(node, content),
        LayoutKind::GroupBox { .. } => layout_group_box_children(node, content, gap),
        LayoutKind::TabView { selected, tabs } => {
            layout_tab_view_children(node, rect, selected, tabs)
        }
        LayoutKind::Column | LayoutKind::Panel => layout_column_children(node, content, gap),
        LayoutKind::Leaf(_) => Vec::new(),
    };

    let mut layout_children = Vec::with_capacity(children_rects.len());
    for (index, (child, child_rect)) in children_rects.into_iter().enumerate() {
        let child_segment = child
            .id
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}-{depth_index}-{index}", kind_slug(&child.kind)));
        layout_children.push(layout_node(
            &path,
            child,
            child_rect,
            child_segment,
            depth_index + 1,
        ));
    }

    LayoutNode {
        path,
        rect,
        data: node.data.clone(),
        children: layout_children,
    }
}

fn kind_slug(kind: &LayoutKind) -> &'static str {
    match kind {
        LayoutKind::Panel => "panel",
        LayoutKind::GroupBox { .. } => "group-box",
        LayoutKind::Row => "row",
        LayoutKind::Column => "column",
        LayoutKind::Stack => "stack",
        LayoutKind::TabView { .. } => "tab-view",
        LayoutKind::Leaf(leaf) => match leaf {
            LayoutLeafKind::Text { .. } => "text",
            LayoutLeafKind::Button { .. } => "button",
            LayoutLeafKind::ProgressBar => "progress-bar",
            LayoutLeafKind::Slider => "slider",
            LayoutLeafKind::Toggle { .. } => "toggle",
            LayoutLeafKind::OptionSet { .. } => "option-set",
            LayoutLeafKind::Dropdown { .. } => "dropdown",
            LayoutLeafKind::ColorPickerRgb => "color-picker-rgb",
            LayoutLeafKind::CurveEditor => "curve-editor",
            LayoutLeafKind::Spacer => "spacer",
        },
    }
}

fn layout_group_box_children<'a, T>(
    node: &'a LayoutElement<T>,
    content: LayoutRect,
    gap: f32,
) -> Vec<(&'a LayoutElement<T>, LayoutRect)> {
    let label_height = group_box_label_height(node.style.font_size);
    let content = LayoutRect::new(
        content.x,
        content.y + label_height,
        content.width,
        (content.height - label_height).max(0.0),
    );
    layout_column_children(node, content, gap)
}

fn layout_tab_view_children<'a, T>(
    node: &'a LayoutElement<T>,
    rect: LayoutRect,
    selected: &str,
    tabs: &[crate::model::LayoutTab],
) -> Vec<(&'a LayoutElement<T>, LayoutRect)> {
    let selected = selected_tab_id(selected, tabs, &node.children);
    let header_height = tab_view_header_height(node.style.font_size, node.style.padding.max(0.0));
    let padding = node.style.padding.max(0.0);
    let content = LayoutRect::new(
        rect.x + padding,
        rect.y + header_height + padding,
        (rect.width - padding * 2.0).max(0.0),
        (rect.height - header_height - padding * 2.0).max(0.0),
    );

    node.children
        .iter()
        .filter(|child| child.id.as_deref() == Some(selected.as_str()))
        .map(|child| (child, content))
        .collect()
}

fn layout_column_children<'a, T>(
    node: &'a LayoutElement<T>,
    content: LayoutRect,
    gap: f32,
) -> Vec<(&'a LayoutElement<T>, LayoutRect)> {
    let mut cursor = content.y;
    let mut laid_out = Vec::with_capacity(node.children.len());
    for child in &node.children {
        let measured = measure_element(child);
        let width = child
            .style
            .width
            .unwrap_or(content.width.max(measured.0))
            .max(0.0);
        let height = child.style.height.unwrap_or(measured.1).max(0.0);
        let x = content.x + child.style.left.unwrap_or(0.0);
        let y = cursor + child.style.top.unwrap_or(0.0);
        laid_out.push((child, LayoutRect::new(x, y, width, height)));
        cursor = y + height + gap;
    }
    laid_out
}

fn layout_row_children<'a, T>(
    node: &'a LayoutElement<T>,
    content: LayoutRect,
    gap: f32,
) -> Vec<(&'a LayoutElement<T>, LayoutRect)> {
    let mut cursor = content.x;
    let mut laid_out = Vec::with_capacity(node.children.len());
    for child in &node.children {
        let measured = measure_element(child);
        let width = child.style.width.unwrap_or(measured.0).max(0.0);
        let height = child
            .style
            .height
            .unwrap_or(content.height.max(measured.1))
            .max(0.0);
        let x = cursor + child.style.left.unwrap_or(0.0);
        let y = content.y + child.style.top.unwrap_or(0.0);
        laid_out.push((child, LayoutRect::new(x, y, width, height)));
        cursor = x + width + gap;
    }
    laid_out
}

fn layout_stack_children<'a, T>(
    node: &'a LayoutElement<T>,
    content: LayoutRect,
) -> Vec<(&'a LayoutElement<T>, LayoutRect)> {
    let mut laid_out = Vec::with_capacity(node.children.len());
    for child in &node.children {
        let measured = measure_element(child);
        let width = child
            .style
            .width
            .unwrap_or(content.width.max(measured.0))
            .max(0.0);
        let height = child
            .style
            .height
            .unwrap_or(content.height.max(measured.1))
            .max(0.0);
        let x = content.x + child.style.left.unwrap_or(0.0);
        let y = content.y + child.style.top.unwrap_or(0.0);
        laid_out.push((
            child,
            LayoutRect::new(x, y, width.min(content.width), height.min(content.height)),
        ));
    }
    laid_out
}

use crate::model::LayoutNode;

pub fn hit_test<T>(node: &LayoutNode<T>, x: f32, y: f32) -> Option<String> {
    if !node.rect.contains(x, y) {
        return None;
    }

    for child in node.children.iter().rev() {
        if let Some(path) = hit_test(child, x, y) {
            return Some(path);
        }
    }

    Some(node.path.clone())
}

pub fn find_layout_node<'a, T>(node: &'a LayoutNode<T>, path: &str) -> Option<&'a LayoutNode<T>> {
    if node.path == path {
        return Some(node);
    }
    for child in &node.children {
        if let Some(found) = find_layout_node(child, path) {
            return Some(found);
        }
    }
    None
}

pub fn flatten_layout<'a, T>(node: &'a LayoutNode<T>) -> Vec<&'a LayoutNode<T>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    flatten_inner(node, &mut out);
    out
}

fn flatten_inner<'a, T>(node: &'a LayoutNode<T>, out: &mut Vec<&'a LayoutNode<T>>) {
    out.push(node);
    for child in &node.children {
        flatten_inner(child, out);
    }
}

use amigo_math::Vec2;

use crate::model::{LayoutElement, LayoutKind, LayoutLeafKind, LayoutTab};

pub(crate) fn measure_element<T>(node: &LayoutElement<T>) -> (f32, f32) {
    let padding = node.style.padding.max(0.0);
    let gap = node.style.gap.max(0.0);

    let intrinsic = match &node.kind {
        LayoutKind::Leaf(leaf) => match leaf {
            LayoutLeafKind::Text { content } => measure_text_block(
                content,
                node.style.width.unwrap_or(0.0),
                node.style.font_size,
                node.style.word_wrap,
                node.style.fit_to_width,
            ),
            LayoutLeafKind::Button { text } => {
                let label = measure_text_block(
                    text,
                    node.style.width.unwrap_or(0.0),
                    node.style.font_size.max(16.0),
                    node.style.word_wrap,
                    node.style.fit_to_width,
                );
                Vec2::new(
                    label.x + padding * 2.0 + 24.0,
                    label.y + padding * 2.0 + 12.0,
                )
            }
            LayoutLeafKind::ProgressBar => Vec2::new(220.0, 18.0),
            LayoutLeafKind::Slider => Vec2::new(220.0, 24.0),
            LayoutLeafKind::Toggle { text } => {
                let label = measure_text_block(
                    text,
                    node.style.width.unwrap_or(0.0),
                    node.style.font_size.max(14.0),
                    node.style.word_wrap,
                    node.style.fit_to_width,
                );
                Vec2::new(label.x + 64.0, label.y.max(22.0) + padding * 2.0)
            }
            LayoutLeafKind::OptionSet { option_count } => {
                Vec2::new((*option_count).max(1) as f32 * 108.0, 38.0)
            }
            LayoutLeafKind::Dropdown { .. } => Vec2::new(220.0, 38.0),
            LayoutLeafKind::ColorPickerRgb => Vec2::new(260.0, 118.0),
            LayoutLeafKind::CurveEditor => Vec2::new(260.0, 118.0),
            LayoutLeafKind::Spacer => Vec2::new(0.0, 0.0),
        },
        LayoutKind::GroupBox { .. } => {
            let children = measure_column_like_children(&node.children, padding, gap);
            Vec2::new(
                children.x,
                children.y + group_box_label_height(node.style.font_size),
            )
        }
        LayoutKind::TabView { selected, tabs } => {
            let selected = selected_tab_id(selected, tabs, &node.children);
            let panel = node
                .children
                .iter()
                .find(|child| child.id.as_deref() == Some(selected.as_str()))
                .map(measure_element)
                .map(|(x, y)| Vec2::new(x, y))
                .unwrap_or(Vec2::new(0.0, 0.0));
            Vec2::new(
                panel.x.max((tabs.len().max(1) as f32) * 108.0) + padding * 2.0,
                panel.y + tab_view_header_height(node.style.font_size, padding) + padding * 2.0,
            )
        }
        LayoutKind::Row => {
            let mut width = 0.0;
            let mut height: f32 = 0.0;
            for (index, child) in node.children.iter().enumerate() {
                let (cw, ch) = measure_element(child);
                width += cw;
                if index > 0 {
                    width += gap;
                }
                height = height.max(ch);
            }
            Vec2::new(width + padding * 2.0, height + padding * 2.0)
        }
        LayoutKind::Column | LayoutKind::Panel => {
            measure_column_like_children(&node.children, padding, gap)
        }
        LayoutKind::Stack => {
            let mut width: f32 = 0.0;
            let mut height: f32 = 0.0;
            for child in &node.children {
                let (cw, ch) = measure_element(child);
                width = width.max(cw);
                height = height.max(ch);
            }
            Vec2::new(width + padding * 2.0, height + padding * 2.0)
        }
    };

    (
        node.style.width.unwrap_or(intrinsic.x).max(0.0),
        node.style.height.unwrap_or(intrinsic.y).max(0.0),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn group_box_label_height(font_size: f32) -> f32 {
    font_size.max(8.0) * 1.2
}

pub(crate) fn tab_view_header_height(font_size: f32, padding: f32) -> f32 {
    (font_size.max(14.0) * 1.2 + padding * 2.0).max(38.0)
}

pub(crate) fn selected_tab_id<T>(
    selected: &str,
    tabs: &[LayoutTab],
    children: &[LayoutElement<T>],
) -> String {
    if tabs.iter().any(|tab| tab.id == selected) {
        return selected.to_owned();
    }
    tabs.first()
        .map(|tab| tab.id.clone())
        .or_else(|| children.iter().find_map(|child| child.id.clone()))
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn measure_column_like_children<T>(children: &[LayoutElement<T>], padding: f32, gap: f32) -> Vec2 {
    let mut width: f32 = 0.0;
    let mut height = 0.0;
    for (index, child) in children.iter().enumerate() {
        let (cw, ch) = measure_element(child);
        width = width.max(cw);
        height += ch;
        if index > 0 {
            height += gap;
        }
    }
    Vec2::new(width + padding * 2.0, height + padding * 2.0)
}

fn measure_text_block(
    content: &str,
    max_width: f32,
    font_size: f32,
    word_wrap: bool,
    fit_to_width: bool,
) -> Vec2 {
    let (effective_font_size, lines) =
        layout_text_lines(content, max_width, font_size, word_wrap, fit_to_width);
    let line_height = effective_font_size.max(8.0) * 1.2;
    let max_line_width = lines
        .iter()
        .map(|line| measure_text_line_width(line, effective_font_size))
        .fold(0.0, f32::max);
    Vec2::new(max_line_width, (lines.len().max(1) as f32) * line_height)
}

fn layout_text_lines(
    content: &str,
    max_width: f32,
    font_size: f32,
    word_wrap: bool,
    fit_to_width: bool,
) -> (f32, Vec<String>) {
    let mut effective_font_size = font_size.max(8.0);
    if fit_to_width && !word_wrap && max_width > 0.0 {
        let width = measure_text_line_width(content, effective_font_size);
        if width > max_width {
            effective_font_size = (effective_font_size * (max_width / width))
                .max(8.0)
                .min(effective_font_size);
        }
    }

    let lines = if word_wrap && max_width > 0.0 {
        wrap_text_lines(content, effective_font_size, max_width)
    } else {
        content.split('\n').map(|line| line.to_owned()).collect()
    };

    (
        effective_font_size,
        if lines.is_empty() {
            vec![String::new()]
        } else {
            lines
        },
    )
}

fn wrap_text_lines(content: &str, font_size: f32, max_width: f32) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    for paragraph in content.split('\n') {
        if paragraph.is_empty() {
            lines.push(String::new());
            continue;
        }

        let mut current = String::new();
        for word in paragraph.split_whitespace() {
            let candidate = if current.is_empty() {
                word.to_owned()
            } else {
                format!("{current} {word}")
            };
            if measure_text_line_width(&candidate, font_size) <= max_width {
                current = candidate;
                continue;
            }

            if !current.is_empty() {
                lines.push(current.clone());
                current.clear();
            }

            if measure_text_line_width(word, font_size) <= max_width {
                current = word.to_owned();
                continue;
            }

            let mut fragment = String::new();
            for ch in word.chars() {
                let candidate = format!("{fragment}{ch}");
                if !fragment.is_empty()
                    && measure_text_line_width(&candidate, font_size) > max_width
                {
                    lines.push(fragment.clone());
                    fragment.clear();
                }
                fragment.push(ch);
            }
            current = fragment;
        }

        if !current.is_empty() {
            lines.push(current);
        }
    }
    lines
}

fn measure_text_line_width(content: &str, font_size: f32) -> f32 {
    let effective_font_size = font_size.max(8.0);
    let pixel_size = effective_font_size / 7.0;
    let advance = 6.0 * pixel_size;
    content.chars().count() as f32 * advance
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct LayoutRect {
    pub x: f32,
    pub y: f32,
    pub width: f32,
    pub height: f32,
}

impl LayoutRect {
    pub const fn new(x: f32, y: f32, width: f32, height: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            x,
            y,
            width,
            height,
        }
    }

    pub fn contains(&self, x: f32, y: f32) -> bool {
        x >= self.x && y >= self.y && x <= self.x + self.width && y <= self.y + self.height
    }

    pub fn inset(self, inset: f32) -> Self {
        let clamped = inset.max(0.0).min(self.width * 0.5).min(self.height * 0.5);
        Self {
            x: self.x + clamped,
            y: self.y + clamped,
            width: (self.width - clamped * 2.0).max(0.0),
            height: (self.height - clamped * 2.0).max(0.0),
        }
    }
}

    }
}

use crate::{
    LayoutElement, LayoutKind, LayoutLeafKind, LayoutStyle, LayoutViewport, LayoutViewportScaling,
    compute_layout, find_layout_node, hit_test,

fn node(
    id: &str,
    kind: LayoutKind,
    style: LayoutStyle,
    children: Vec<LayoutElement<String>>,
) -> LayoutElement<String> {
    LayoutElement {
        id: Some(id.to_owned()),
        kind,
        style,
        data: id.to_owned(),
        children,
    }
}

fn leaf(id: &str, kind: LayoutLeafKind, style: LayoutStyle) -> LayoutElement<String> {
    node(id, LayoutKind::Leaf(kind), style, Vec::new())
}

#[test]
fn column_layout_stacks_children_with_padding_and_gap() {
    let root = node(
        "root",
        LayoutKind::Column,
        LayoutStyle {
            width: Some(300.0),
            height: Some(200.0),
            padding: 10.0,
            gap: 5.0,
            ..LayoutStyle::default()
        },
        vec![
            leaf(
                "a",
                LayoutLeafKind::Spacer,
                LayoutStyle {
                    width: Some(100.0),
                    height: Some(20.0),
                    ..LayoutStyle::default()
                },
            ),
            leaf(
                "b",
                LayoutLeafKind::Spacer,
                LayoutStyle {
                    width: Some(100.0),
                    height: Some(30.0),
                    ..LayoutStyle::default()
                },
            ),
        ],
    );

    let layout = compute_layout("doc", LayoutViewport::new(300.0, 200.0), &root, None);
    let a = find_layout_node(&layout, "doc.root.a").expect("a node");
    let b = find_layout_node(&layout, "doc.root.b").expect("b node");

    assert_eq!(a.rect.x, 10.0);
    assert_eq!(a.rect.y, 10.0);
    assert_eq!(a.rect.width, 100.0);
    assert_eq!(a.rect.height, 20.0);

    assert_eq!(b.rect.x, 10.0);
    assert_eq!(b.rect.y, 35.0);
    assert_eq!(b.rect.width, 100.0);
    assert_eq!(b.rect.height, 30.0);
}

#[test]
fn row_layout_places_children_left_to_right() {

#[test]
fn hit_test_returns_deepest_node() {

        LayoutKind::Stack,
        LayoutStyle {
            width: Some(300.0),

fn fit_viewport_scales_and_centers_document() {

use crate::model::{LayoutNode, LayoutRect, LayoutViewport, LayoutViewportScaling};

pub(crate) fn transform_layout_for_viewport<T: Clone>(
    layout: LayoutNode<T>,
    viewport: LayoutViewport,
    document_viewport: Option<(LayoutViewport, LayoutViewportScaling)>,
) -> LayoutNode<T> {
    let Some((document_viewport, scaling_mode)) = document_viewport else {
        return layout;
    };

    if scaling_mode == LayoutViewportScaling::Expand {
        return layout;
    }

    let design_width = document_viewport.width.max(1.0);
    let design_height = document_viewport.height.max(1.0);
    let scale = match scaling_mode {
        LayoutViewportScaling::Expand => 1.0,
        LayoutViewportScaling::Fixed => 1.0,
        LayoutViewportScaling::Fit => {
            (viewport.width / design_width).min(viewport.height / design_height)
        }
    }
    .max(0.0);

    let offset_x = (viewport.width - design_width * scale) * 0.5;
    let offset_y = (viewport.height - design_height * scale) * 0.5;

    transform_layout_node(layout, offset_x, offset_y, scale)
}

fn transform_layout_node<T: Clone>(
    node: LayoutNode<T>,
    offset_x: f32,
    offset_y: f32,
    scale: f32,
) -> LayoutNode<T> {
    LayoutNode {
        path: node.path,
        rect: LayoutRect::new(
            offset_x + node.rect.x * scale,
            offset_y + node.rect.y * scale,
            node.rect.width * scale,
            node.rect.height * scale,
        ),
        data: node.data,
        children: node
            .children
            .into_iter()
            .map(|child| transform_layout_node(child, offset_x, offset_y, scale))
            .collect(),
    }
}

# Render Composition

The render API exposes:

- `RenderSpace`
- `RenderLayerId`
- `CameraBinding`
- `CompositionLayer`

The target model is:

- `World3D`
- `World2D`
- `Screen2D`
- `Ui`
- `Gizmos`
- `DebugOverlay`
- `Present`

Legacy pass names such as `World`, `GameUi`, and `DebugOverlay` may still exist during migration, but composition should progressively move toward layer-based render planning.

# Runtime Bundles

`crates/runtime/bundles` composes runtime plugins and backend bridges.

It may:

- register domain plugins,
- register backend bridges,
- assemble runtime presets.

It must not:

- own domain logic,
- become a second app,
- duplicate domain extractors,
- know domain internals beyond plugin composition,
- reintroduce `App*RenderExtractor` names outside `apps/app`.

The WGPU render extractor module is a backend bridge. It may adapt domain
extractors into `WgpuRenderFramePacket`, but domain extraction logic must remain
in domain crates.

# Runtime Refactor Status

## Done

- `apps/app/src/scene_runtime/handlers` removed.
- `apps/app/src/script_runtime/handlers` removed.
- Domain systems moved out of app.
- App no longer depends directly on 2D/3D/audio/UI domain crates.
- Devtools moved to `crates/engine/devtools`.
- Runtime bundles moved to `crates/runtime/bundles`.
- Camera API exists in `crates/engine/camera`.
- Editor placeholder APIs exist in `crates/engine/editor-api` and `crates/engine/editor-session`.

## Current Seams

- `apps/app/src/render_runtime.rs` still orchestrates host render frame submission.
- `crates/runtime/bundles/src/wgpu_render_extractors` is a backend bridge.
- `CompositionLayer` and `RenderSpace` are integrated as transition metadata while legacy pass planning remains.
- Editor APIs are placeholders only. No full editor application exists.

## Rules

- Do not add domain imports to `apps/app`.
- Do not move domain logic into `runtime/bundles`.
- Do not add UI framework dependencies to `editor-api` or `editor-session`.
- Do not build `apps/editor` yet.

# Editor Icon Font

The ingame editor uses a real TTF icon font only for compact decorative icons in tree rows and render-stack rows.

## Asset

- Font: Font Awesome Free Solid 6.x
- Asset key: `core/fonts/fontawesome-free-solid`
- Files: `mods/core/fonts/fontawesome-free-solid/fa-solid-900.ttf`, `LICENSE.txt`, `font.yml`
- License: Font Awesome Free font files are covered by the bundled OFL license.

## Rendering Rule

Normal editor labels stay on the existing bitmap text path (`font: None`) so the editor remains readable if a TTF asset fails to load. Icon glyphs are rendered as separate small `Text` nodes with `font: Some(core/fonts/fontawesome-free-solid)`.

## Current Mapping

| Semantic icon | Glyph code | Label fallback |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scene / Entity | `U+F007` | `Scene`, `Entity` |
| Image / Visual2D | `U+F03E` | `Image`, `Visual` |
| Component / Text / UI | `U+F1C5` | `Component`, `Text`, `UI` |
| Draw Layer | `U+F5FD` | `Layer` |
| Camera | `U+F030` | `Camera` |
| Light | `U+F0EB` | `Light` |
| Post FX | `U+F0D0` | `Post FX` |
| Raw YAML nodes | `U+F1C9` | `Raw Map`, `Raw List`, `Raw Value` |
| Prefab / Use / Override | `U+F0C1` | `Prefab`, `Use`, `Override` |
| Particle / Route | `U+F0E7` | `Particles`, `Route` |
| Mod | `U+F085` | `Mod` |

Labels are kept next to icons because icons alone are not a reliable editor navigation model.

# Ingame Editor MVP Checklist

Current MVP scope: runtime-only / mock-only ingame editor for `rotten-club/main-menu`.

## Launch

```bash
cargo run -p amigo-app -- --editor
```

Expected:

- app starts in editor mode,
- target mod is `rotten-club`,
- target scene is `main-menu`,
- F3 toggles editor overlay,
- Ctrl+E toggles editor overlay.
- editor host window is maximized,
- game content is framed by the center viewport wrapper at logical `1280x720`.

## Tree

- YAML tree renders.
- Selected row is highlighted.
- Collapse/expand markers use clean unicode:
  - `â–¾` expanded,
  - `â–¸` collapsed.
- `editor.tree.filter rain` filters tree.
- `editor.tree.filter.clear` clears filter.
- `editor.tree.expand_all` expands tree.
- `editor.tree.collapse_all` collapses tree.
- Hidden selected node shows warning in properties panel.

## Inspector

- Properties come from `AuthoringPropertyPanel`.
- `editor-ingame` does not decide which properties exist.
- Component properties are generated from scene component descriptors.
- Slider ranges/steps come from descriptor constraints when available.
- Dynamic LayeredImage layer overrides are appended by `editor-authoring`.
- Unknown YAML nodes fall back to generic readonly/editable YAML properties.

## Viewport

- Center viewport remains transparent so game render is visible underneath.
- Middle mouse drag updates editor viewport pan state.
- Left click inside the viewport maps screen coordinates into logical game coordinates.
- Viewport selection syncs selected tree node and inspector.
- Selected viewport target shows a bounding box overlay.

## Runtime bindings

Must work:

- RenderLayerOpacity.
- RenderLayerVisible.
- RenderLayerOrder.
- LayeredImageBaseOpacity.
- LayeredImageLayerOpacity.
- LayeredImageLayerEnabled.
- ParticleEmitterProperty for supported numeric/bool fields.

Mock-only but must not crash:

- PostFxMock.
- Mock light group/route properties.
- Unsupported particle fields.
- Prefab/use readonly panels.

## Console commands

- `editor.tree`
- `editor.selected`
- `editor.node <node-id>`
- `editor.inspect [node-id]`
- `editor.properties [node-id]`
- `editor.viewport`
- `editor.selection`
- `editor.hit <x> <y>`
- `editor.reload`
- `editor.layer.opacity <layer-id> <value>`
- `editor.layered.opacity <entity> <layer-id> <value>`

## Not in this MVP

- YAML save.
- Undo/redo.
- Asset browser.
- Standalone editor app.
- Docking/resize panels.
- Full prefab resolver.
- Custom shader/effect pipeline.

fn on_enter() {
    let active_mod = world.mod.current_id();

    if !world.entities.exists("core-game-mod") {
        world.entities.create("core-game-mod");
    }

    if world.runtime.dev_mode() && !world.entities.exists("core-game-dev-mode") {
        world.entities.create("core-game-dev-mode");
    }

    for mod_id in world.mod.loaded() {
        let marker = "mod:" + mod_id;

        if !world.entities.exists(marker) {
            world.entities.create(marker);
        }
    }

    world.dev.log("core-game mod runtime entered for mod=" + active_mod);
    world.dev.log("window backend=" + world.runtime.window_backend());
    world.dev.log("input backend=" + world.runtime.input_backend());
    world.dev.log("render backend=" + world.runtime.render_backend());
    world.dev.log("script backend=" + world.runtime.script_backend());
    world.dev.log("runtime capabilities=" + world.runtime.capabilities().len);
    world.dev.log("runtime plugins=" + world.runtime.plugins().len);
    world.dev.log("runtime services=" + world.runtime.services().len);
    world.dev.log("assets registered=" + world.assets.registered().len);
    world.dev.log("assets loaded=" + world.assets.loaded().len);
    world.dev.log("assets prepared=" + world.assets.prepared().len);
    world.dev.log("assets failed=" + world.assets.failed().len);
    world.dev.log("assets pending=" + world.assets.pending().len);
    world.dev.log("active mod assets=" + world.assets.by_mod(active_mod).len);

    for scene_id in world.mod.scenes() {
        world.dev.log("available scene for " + active_mod + ": " + scene_id);
    }
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "core-game.scene-ready" && payload.len > 0 {
        let scene_id = payload[0];
        let marker = "scene:" + scene_id;

        if !world.entities.exists(marker) {
            world.entities.create(marker);
        }

        world.dev.event("core-game.bootstrapped", scene_id);
        world.dev.log(
            "core-game dev shell bootstrapped for mod="
            + world.mod.current_id()
            + " scene="
            + scene_id
        );
    }

    if topic == "core-game.refresh-diagnostics" && payload.len > 0 {
        world.dev.refresh_diagnostics(payload[0]);
    }

    ()
}

import "pkg:amigo.std/input" as input;

let demo_square = world.entities.named("playground-2d-demo-square");
let demo_spritesheet = world.entities.named("playground-2d-demo-spritesheet");

fn on_enter() {
    let available_scenes = world.scene.available();
    let runtime_window = world.runtime.window_backend();
    let runtime_render = world.runtime.render_backend();
    let square_asset = world.assets.get("playground-2d/spritesheets/square");
    let spritesheet_asset = world.assets.get("playground-2d/spritesheets/hello-world-spritesheet");

    world.dev.log("entered basic-scripting-demo for mod=" + world.mod.current_id());
    world.dev.log("runtime=" + runtime_window + "/" + runtime_render);
    world.dev.log("scene-count=" + available_scenes.len);
    world.dev.log("square-asset=" + square_asset.state());
    world.dev.log("spritesheet-asset=" + spritesheet_asset.state());
    world.dev.event("playground-2d.demo.entered", world.scene.current_id());
}

fn update(dt) {
    let speed = 2.0;

    if input::down(world, "demo.move_left") {
        demo_square.rotate_2d(-speed * dt);
    }

    if input::down(world, "demo.move_right") {
        demo_square.rotate_2d(speed * dt);
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "demo.advance_frame") {
        let demo_sheet_name = demo_spritesheet.name();
        world.sprite2d.advance(demo_sheet_name, 1.0 / 8.0);
        let frame = world.sprite2d.frame(demo_sheet_name);
        world.dev.log("basic-scripting-demo frame=" + frame);
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "demo.reset_frame") {
        world.sprite2d.set_frame(demo_spritesheet.name(), 0);
        world.dev.log("basic-scripting-demo frame reset");
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "demo.goto_spritesheet") {
        world.dev.event("playground-2d.demo.goto-spritesheet");
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "demo.reload_scene") {
        world.scene.reload();
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "demo.log_time") {
        let delta = world.time.delta();
        let elapsed = world.time.elapsed();
        let frame = world.time.frame();

        world.dev.log("time-delta=" + delta);
        world.dev.log("time-elapsed=" + elapsed);
        world.dev.log("time-frame=" + frame);
        world.dev.command("help");
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "demo.refresh_diagnostics") {
        world.dev.refresh_diagnostics(world.mod.current_id());
    }
}

import "pkg:amigo.std/input" as input;

let square = world.entities.named("playground-2d-square");

fn update(dt) {
    let speed = 2.0;

    if input::down(world, "square.move_left") {
        square.rotate_2d(-speed * dt);
    }

    if input::down(world, "square.move_right") {
        square.rotate_2d(speed * dt);
    }

    ()
}

import "pkg:amigo.std/input" as input;

let square = world.entities.named("playground-2d-ui-preview-square");

let hp = 0.82;
let energy = 0.55;
let threat = 0.35;
let shield_online = true;
let repair_cooldown = 0.0;
let mission_time = 0.0;
let toast_time = 0.0;
let toast_message = "";

fn subtitle_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.hud-card.subtitle" }
fn hp_bar_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.hud-card.hp-bar" }
fn energy_bar_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.hud-card.energy-bar" }
fn threat_bar_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.hud-card.threat-bar" }
fn shield_value_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.hud-card.status-row.shield-box.shield-value" }
fn system_value_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.hud-card.status-row.system-box.system-value" }
fn objective_value_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.mission-card.objective-value" }
fn phase_value_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.mission-card.phase-value" }
fn repair_button_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.control-card.button-row.repair-button" }
fn shield_button_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.control-card.button-row.shield-button" }
fn stabilize_button_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.control-card.stabilize-button" }
fn event_toast_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.event-toast" }
fn event_toast_text_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.event-toast.event-toast-text" }
fn critical_alert_path() { "playground-2d-ui-preview.root.critical-alert" }

fn clamp01(value) {
    if value < 0.0 { return 0.0; }
    if value > 1.0 { return 1.0; }
    value
}

fn phase_label(current_time) {
    if current_time < 10.0 { return "WAVE 01"; }
    if current_time < 20.0 { return "WAVE 02"; }
    "WAVE 03"
}

fn objective_label(current_hp, shield_active, current_threat) {
    if current_hp < 0.18 { return "OBJECTIVE: STABILIZE HULL"; }
    if !shield_active { return "OBJECTIVE: RESTORE SHIELD"; }
    if current_threat > 0.72 { return "OBJECTIVE: BLEED THREAT"; }
    "OBJECTIVE: SURVIVE CALIBRATION"
}

fn status_label(current_hp, current_threat) {
    if current_hp < 0.18 { return "CRITICAL"; }
    if current_hp < 0.45 || current_threat > 0.75 { return "WARNING"; }
    "STABLE"
}

fn subtitle_label(current_hp, shield_active, current_threat) {
    if current_hp < 0.18 { return "Critical damage detected"; }
    if !shield_active { return "Shield offline - hull exposed"; }
    if current_threat > 0.75 { return "Threat spike detected"; }
    "Rhai combat loop active"
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.dev.event("playground-2d.ui-preview.entered", world.scene.current_id());
    world.ui.hide(event_toast_path());
    world.ui.hide(critical_alert_path());
    world.ui.set_text(subtitle_path(), subtitle_label(hp, shield_online, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(shield_value_path(), if shield_online { "ONLINE" } else { "OFFLINE" });
    world.ui.set_text(system_value_path(), status_label(hp, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(objective_value_path(), objective_label(hp, shield_online, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(phase_value_path(), phase_label(mission_time));
    world.ui.set_text(shield_button_path(), "Disable Shield");
    world.ui.enable(repair_button_path());
    world.ui.set_text(repair_button_path(), "Repair Pulse");
    world.ui.enable(stabilize_button_path());
    world.ui.set_value(hp_bar_path(), hp);
    world.ui.set_value(energy_bar_path(), energy);
    world.ui.set_value(threat_bar_path(), threat);
}

fn update(dt) {
    mission_time = mission_time + dt;
    square.rotate_2d(dt * (0.45 + threat));

    threat = clamp01(threat + dt * 0.04);
    energy = clamp01(energy + dt * 0.06);

    if shield_online {
        energy = clamp01(energy - dt * 0.02);
    }

    if !shield_online && threat > 0.6 {
        hp = clamp01(hp - dt * 0.1);
    }

    if threat > 0.85 {
        hp = clamp01(hp - dt * 0.05);
    }

    let move_x = input::axis(world, "preview.move_x");
    let move_y = input::axis(world, "preview.move_y");

    if move_x < -0.01 {
        hp = clamp01(hp - dt * 0.3);
    }

    if move_x > 0.01 {
        hp = clamp01(hp + dt * 0.2);
    }

    if move_y > 0.01 {
        energy = clamp01(energy + dt * 0.3);
    }

    if move_y < -0.01 {
        threat = clamp01(threat - dt * 0.3);
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "preview.repair") {
        if repair_cooldown > 0.0 {
            toast_message = "REPAIR COOLING";
            toast_time = 0.9;
        } else if energy < 0.2 {
            toast_message = "NOT ENOUGH ENERGY";
            toast_time = 0.9;
        } else {
            hp = clamp01(hp + 0.24);
            energy = clamp01(energy - 0.2);
            threat = clamp01(threat - 0.08);
            repair_cooldown = 2.4;
            toast_message = "REPAIR PULSE ACTIVATED";
            toast_time = 1.2;
        }
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "preview.toggle_shield") {
        shield_online = !shield_online;
        if shield_online {
            toast_message = "SHIELD ONLINE";
            toast_time = 1.0;
        } else {
            toast_message = "SHIELD OFFLINE";
            toast_time = 1.0;
        }
    }

    if input::pressed(world, "preview.stabilize") {
        if energy < 0.15 {
            toast_message = "CAPACITOR TOO LOW";
            toast_time = 0.9;
        } else {
            energy = clamp01(energy - 0.15);
            threat = clamp01(threat - 0.26);
            toast_message = "THREAT DAMPENED";
            toast_time = 1.0;
        }
    }

    let had_cooldown = repair_cooldown > 0.0;
    if repair_cooldown > 0.0 {
        repair_cooldown = repair_cooldown - dt;
        if repair_cooldown < 0.0 {
            repair_cooldown = 0.0;
        }
    }

    if had_cooldown && repair_cooldown == 0.0 {
        toast_message = "REPAIR READY";
        toast_time = 0.8;
    }

    if toast_time > 0.0 {
        toast_time = toast_time - dt;
        if toast_time < 0.0 {
            toast_time = 0.0;
            toast_message = "";
        }
    }

    world.ui.set_text(subtitle_path(), subtitle_label(hp, shield_online, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(shield_value_path(), if shield_online { "ONLINE" } else { "OFFLINE" });
    world.ui.set_text(system_value_path(), status_label(hp, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(objective_value_path(), objective_label(hp, shield_online, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(phase_value_path(), phase_label(mission_time));

    if shield_online {
        world.ui.set_text(shield_button_path(), "Disable Shield");
    } else {
        world.ui.set_text(shield_button_path(), "Enable Shield");
    }

    if repair_cooldown > 0.0 {
        world.ui.disable(repair_button_path());
        world.ui.set_text(repair_button_path(), "Repair Cooling");
    } else {
        world.ui.enable(repair_button_path());
        world.ui.set_text(repair_button_path(), "Repair Pulse");
    }

    if energy < 0.15 {
        world.ui.disable(stabilize_button_path());
    } else {
        world.ui.enable(stabilize_button_path());
    }

    if hp < 0.18 {
        world.ui.show(critical_alert_path());
    } else {
        world.ui.hide(critical_alert_path());
    }

    if toast_time > 0.0 {
        world.ui.set_text(event_toast_text_path(), toast_message);
        world.ui.show(event_toast_path());
    } else {
        world.ui.hide(event_toast_path());
    }

    world.ui.set_value(hp_bar_path(), hp);
    world.ui.set_value(energy_bar_path(), energy);
    world.ui.set_value(threat_bar_path(), threat);
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "playground-2d.ui-preview.repair-clicked" {
        if repair_cooldown > 0.0 {
            toast_message = "REPAIR COOLING";
            toast_time = 0.9;
        } else if energy < 0.2 {
            toast_message = "NOT ENOUGH ENERGY";
            toast_time = 0.9;
        } else {
            hp = clamp01(hp + 0.24);
            energy = clamp01(energy - 0.2);
            threat = clamp01(threat - 0.08);
            repair_cooldown = 2.4;
            toast_message = "REPAIR PULSE ACTIVATED";
            toast_time = 1.2;
        }
    }

    if topic == "playground-2d.ui-preview.shield-clicked" {
        shield_online = !shield_online;
        if shield_online {
            toast_message = "SHIELD ONLINE";
            toast_time = 1.0;
        } else {
            toast_message = "SHIELD OFFLINE";
            toast_time = 1.0;
        }
    }

    if topic == "playground-2d.ui-preview.stabilize-clicked" {
        if energy < 0.15 {
            toast_message = "CAPACITOR TOO LOW";
            toast_time = 0.9;
        } else {
            energy = clamp01(energy - 0.15);
            threat = clamp01(threat - 0.26);
            toast_message = "THREAT DAMPENED";
            toast_time = 1.0;
        }
    }

    world.ui.set_text(subtitle_path(), subtitle_label(hp, shield_online, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(shield_value_path(), if shield_online { "ONLINE" } else { "OFFLINE" });
    world.ui.set_text(system_value_path(), status_label(hp, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(objective_value_path(), objective_label(hp, shield_online, threat));
    world.ui.set_text(phase_value_path(), phase_label(mission_time));

    if shield_online {
        world.ui.set_text(shield_button_path(), "Disable Shield");
    } else {
        world.ui.set_text(shield_button_path(), "Enable Shield");
    }

    if repair_cooldown > 0.0 {
        world.ui.disable(repair_button_path());
        world.ui.set_text(repair_button_path(), "Repair Cooling");
    } else {
        world.ui.enable(repair_button_path());
        world.ui.set_text(repair_button_path(), "Repair Pulse");
    }

    if energy < 0.15 {
        world.ui.disable(stabilize_button_path());
    } else {
        world.ui.enable(stabilize_button_path());
    }

    if hp < 0.18 {
        world.ui.show(critical_alert_path());
    } else {
        world.ui.hide(critical_alert_path());
    }

    if toast_time > 0.0 {
        world.ui.set_text(event_toast_text_path(), toast_message);
        world.ui.show(event_toast_path());
    } else {
        world.ui.hide(event_toast_path());
    }

    world.ui.set_value(hp_bar_path(), hp);
    world.ui.set_value(energy_bar_path(), energy);
    world.ui.set_value(threat_bar_path(), threat);
}

fn on_attach(entity, params) {
    world.state.set_string(entity + ".component.label", params.label);
    world.state.set_float(entity + ".component.elapsed", 0.0);
    world.dev.event("playground-2d.demo.component.attach", entity);
}

fn update(entity, params, dt) {
    let elapsed_key = entity + ".component.elapsed";
    let elapsed = world.state.get_float(elapsed_key);
    world.state.set_float(elapsed_key, elapsed + dt * params.speed);
}

fn on_detach(entity, params) {
    world.dev.event("playground-2d.demo.component.detach", entity);
}

SNAPSHOT_ID: yrdal
FILE: mods/playground-2d-asteroids/README.md
LINES: 38
====================================================================================================
# Asteroids

Procedural, vector-first 2D playground mod for early Asteroids-style engine work.

Current scope:

- native `vector_2d` scene components
- WGPU stroke/fill rendering for simple vector shapes
- generated synthetic arcade SFX for shot, thrust, asteroid hits, wave progression, respawn protection, and game over cues
- lightweight runtime-owned `CircleCollider2D` overlap queries exposed through `world.physics`
- runtime vector mutation API exposed through `world.vector` for procedural shape updates
- no sprite assets
- no world wrap yet
- no full rigid-body or wrap-around gameplay physics yet

The first slice is intentionally small and exists to validate:

1. scene YAML -> vector hydration
2. runtime scene queueing
3. vector rendering in hosted mode
4. first playable ship / bullet / asteroid loop without bitmap assets
5. thin collision seam from scene components into Rhai through `world.physics.overlaps(...)`
6. first bounded two-wave arena flow before world-wrap work

Audio notes:

- all Asteroids SFX in this mod are procedural `generated-audio` metadata assets
- `thrust.yml` adds a soft low-frequency engine pulse intended for short boost/thrust accents
- `wave-start.yml` is a short upward cue for spawning/announcing the next wave
- `sector-clear.yml` is a brighter progression sting for clearing the current arena slice
- `respawn-shield.yml` is a soft protective cue for ship respawn / temporary invulnerability beats

Scene polish notes:

- the arena now uses a full black vector backdrop and a larger field/frame footprint tuned for full-window readability
- the HUD copy is tuned to feel a bit more arcade-like while keeping the same ids and script wiring
- the scene now runs a real second wave using additional off-screen-staged asteroid entities instead of stopping after the first clear
- asteroid silhouettes are generated procedurally in script and pushed into runtime via `world.vector.set_polygon(...)`

import "pkg:amigo.std/input" as input;

fn ship_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-ship" }
fn shield_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-ship-shield" }
fn thrust_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-main-thruster" }
fn starfield_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-speed-starfield" }
fn bullet_pool() { "player-bullets" }
fn asteroid_pool() { "asteroids" }

fn game_over_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-game-over" }
fn hud_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-hud" }
fn status_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-center-status" }
fn ui_root(entity_name) { entity_name + ".root" }

fn shield_seconds() { 3.0 }
fn wave_clear_delay() { 1.2 }
fn status_flash_seconds() { 0.95 }
fn ship_spawn_rotation() { 1.5707963 }

fn mode(world_api) { world_api.state.get_string("game_mode") }
fn set_mode(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_string("game_mode", value); }
fn score(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("score") }
fn set_score(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("score", value); }
fn lives(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("lives") }
fn set_lives(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("lives", value); }
fn wave(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("wave") }
fn set_wave(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("wave", value); }
fn low_mode(world_api) { world_api.session.get_bool("asteroids.low_mode") }
fn rng_seed(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("rng_seed") }
fn set_rng_seed(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("rng_seed", value); }

fn pad_two(value) {
    if value < 10 { return "0" + value; }
    return "" + value;
}

fn pad_score(value) {
    if value < 10 { return "00000" + value; }
    if value < 100 { return "0000" + value; }
    if value < 1000 { return "000" + value; }
    if value < 10000 { return "00" + value; }
    if value < 100000 { return "0" + value; }
    return "" + value;
}

fn clamp_int(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value { return min_value; }
    if value > max_value { return max_value; }
    return value;
}

fn max_float(left, right) {
    if left > right { return left; }
    return right;
}

fn abs_float(value) {
    if value < 0.0 { return -value; }
    return value;
}

fn clamp_float(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value { return min_value; }
    if value > max_value { return max_value; }
    return value;
}

fn thrust_hold(world_api) { world_api.state.get_float("ship.thrust_hold"); }
fn set_thrust_hold(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_float("ship.thrust_hold", value); }

fn rand_next(world_api) {
    let next = (rng_seed(world_api) * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 4294967296;
    if next < 0 { next = -next; }
    set_rng_seed(world_api, next);
    return next;
}

fn rand01(world_api) {
    return rand_next(world_api) / 4294967296.0;
}

fn rand_range(world_api, min_value, max_value) {
    return min_value + (max_value - min_value) * rand01(world_api);
}

fn rand_int(world_api, min_value, max_value) {
    let span = max_value - min_value + 1;
    return min_value + (rand_next(world_api) % span);
}

fn sync_hud(world_api) {
    world_api.state.set_string("score_text", pad_score(score(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("lives_text", "LIVES " + lives(world_api));
    world_api.state.set_string("wave_text", "WAVE " + pad_two(wave(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("final_score_text", "SCORE " + pad_score(score(world_api)));
}

fn set_status(world_api, value) {
    world_api.state.set_bool("status_auto_clear", false);
    world_api.state.set_string("status_text", value);
    if value == "" {
        world_api.entities.hide(status_name());
        world_api.ui.hide(ui_root(status_name()));
    } else {
        world_api.entities.show(status_name());
        world_api.ui.show(ui_root(status_name()));
    }
}

fn set_timed_status(world_api, value, seconds) {
    set_status(world_api, value);
    world_api.state.set_bool("status_auto_clear", true);
    world_api.timers.start("status-clear", seconds);
}

fn update_status(world_api) {
    if world_api.state.get_bool("status_auto_clear") && world_api.timers.ready("status-clear") {
        world_api.state.set_bool("status_auto_clear", false);
        set_status(world_api, "");
    }
}

fn show_gameplay_ui(world_api) {
    world_api.entities.hide(game_over_name());
    world_api.ui.hide(ui_root(game_over_name()));
    world_api.entities.show(hud_name());
    world_api.ui.show(ui_root(hud_name()));
}

fn highscore(world_api, index) {
    return world_api.session.get_int("asteroids.highscore." + index);
}

fn set_highscore(world_api, index, value) {
    world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore." + index, value);
}

fn maybe_insert_highscore(world_api, value) {
    if value > highscore(world_api, 1) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, highscore(world_api, 3));
        set_highscore(world_api, 3, highscore(world_api, 2));
        set_highscore(world_api, 2, highscore(world_api, 1));
        set_highscore(world_api, 1, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 2) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, highscore(world_api, 3));
        set_highscore(world_api, 3, highscore(world_api, 2));
        set_highscore(world_api, 2, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 3) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, highscore(world_api, 3));
        set_highscore(world_api, 3, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 4) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 5) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, value);
    }
}

fn reset_player(world_api) {
    world_api.entities.set_position_2d(ship_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.entities.set_position_2d(shield_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.entities.set_rotation_2d(ship_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.entities.set_rotation_2d(shield_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.motion.reset_freeflight(ship_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.motion.reset_freeflight(shield_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.motion.set_velocity(ship_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.motion.set_velocity(shield_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(thrust_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(thrust_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
    set_thrust_hold(world_api, 0.0);
    world_api.entities.show(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.enable(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.set_collision_enabled(ship_name(), true);
    world_api.entities.show(shield_name());
    world_api.timers.start("ship-shield", shield_seconds());
}

fn start_new_game(world_api) {
    world_api.timers.reset_scene();
    set_score(world_api, 0);
    set_lives(world_api, 3);
    set_wave(world_api, 1);
    set_rng_seed(world_api, 1337);
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        set_rng_seed(world_api, 7331);
    }

    world_api.pools.release_all(bullet_pool());
    world_api.pools.release_all(asteroid_pool());
    show_gameplay_ui(world_api);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    set_timed_status(world_api, "READY", status_flash_seconds());
    reset_player(world_api);
    set_mode(world_api, "playing");
    start_wave(world_api, 1);
    world_api.audio.play("wave-start");
}

fn wave_asteroid_count(world_api, current_wave) {
    let base = 3 + current_wave;
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        base = base - 1;
    }
    return clamp_int(base, 3, 16);
}

fn wave_speed_min(world_api, current_wave) {
    let value = 55.0 + current_wave * 8.0;
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        return value * 0.72;
    }
    return value;
}

fn wave_speed_max(world_api, current_wave) {
    let value = 110.0 + current_wave * 12.0;
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        return value * 0.72;
    }
    return value;
}

fn wave_radius_min(current_wave) {
    return max_float(14.0, 34.0 - current_wave * 1.2);
}

fn wave_radius_max() { 44.0 }

fn score_for_radius(radius) {
    if radius >= 34.0 { return 20; }
    if radius >= 22.0 { return 50; }
    return 100;
}

fn smooth_step(value) {
    let t = clamp_float(value, 0.0, 1.0);
    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t);
}

fn ease_in_out_cubic(value) {
    let t = clamp_float(value, 0.0, 1.0);
    if t < 0.5 {
        return 4.0 * t * t * t;
    }
    let f = -2.0 * t + 2.0;
    return 1.0 - f * f * f / 2.0;
}

fn update_speed_starfield(world_api, thrust_axis, dt) {
    if thrust_axis <= 0.01 {
        set_thrust_hold(world_api, 0.0);
    } else {
        set_thrust_hold(world_api, clamp_float(thrust_hold(world_api) + dt, 0.0, 5.0));
    }

    let intensity = clamp_float((thrust_axis - 0.82) / 0.18, 0.0, 1.0);
    let ramp_raw = clamp_float((thrust_hold(world_api) - 0.72) / 1.35, 0.0, 1.0);
    let ramp = ease_in_out_cubic(ramp_raw);
    let streak = smooth_step(ramp * ramp);
    let motion = world_api.motion.state(ship_name());
    let speed_sq = motion.velocity_x * motion.velocity_x + motion.velocity_y * motion.velocity_y;

    if intensity <= 0.01 || ramp <= 0.01 || speed_sq < 115000.0 {
        world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
        world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
        return;
    }

    let chaos_phase = (thrust_hold(world_api) * 21.0).to_int() % 4;
    let chaos = 0.0;
    if chaos_phase == 0 { chaos = 1.0 * ramp; }
    if chaos_phase == 1 { chaos = 0.45 * ramp; }

    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), true);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), intensity * ramp);
    world_api.particles.set_local_direction_degrees(starfield_name(), motion.angle_radians * 57.29578 + 180.0);
    world_api.particles.set_spawn_rate(starfield_name(), 32.0 + 112.0 * intensity * ramp + 42.0 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_lifetime(starfield_name(), 0.26 + 0.42 * ramp + 0.035 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_lifetime_jitter(starfield_name(), 0.06 + 0.045 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_speed(starfield_name(), 320.0 + 380.0 * intensity * ramp + 72.0 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_speed_jitter(starfield_name(), 44.0 + 92.0 * ramp + 32.0 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_spread_degrees(starfield_name(), 1.2 + 1.4 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_initial_size(starfield_name(), 0.16 + 0.18 * ramp);
    world_api.particles.set_final_size(starfield_name(), 0.55 + 1.35 * streak + 0.35 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_shape_line(starfield_name(), 3.0 + 20.0 * streak + 4.0 * chaos);
}

fn split_radius(radius) {
    if radius >= 34.0 { return radius * 0.58; }
    if radius >= 22.0 { return radius * 0.62; }
    return 0.0;
}

fn asteroid_size_for_radius(radius) {
    if radius >= 34.0 { return "large"; }
    if radius >= 22.0 { return "medium"; }
    return "small";
}

fn fragment_speed(world_api, parent_speed) {
    let min_speed = wave_speed_min(world_api, wave(world_api)) * 1.15;
    let speed = parent_speed * 1.18;
    return max_float(min_speed, speed);
}

fn random_spawn_position_away_from_center(world_api) {
    let origin = world_api.entities.position_2d(ship_name());
    let x = rand_range(world_api, -860.0, 860.0);
    let y = rand_range(world_api, -460.0, 460.0);

    if abs_float(x) < 220.0 && abs_float(y) < 180.0 {
        if abs_float(x) < abs_float(y) {
            if y >= 0.0 { y = 260.0; } else { y = -260.0; }
        } else {
            if x >= 0.0 { x = 300.0; } else { x = -300.0; }
        }
    }

    return #{ x: origin.x + x, y: origin.y + y };
}

fn direction_x(index) {
    if index == 0 { return 1.0; }
    if index == 1 { return 0.7071; }
    if index == 2 { return 0.0; }
    if index == 3 { return -0.7071; }
    if index == 4 { return -1.0; }
    if index == 5 { return -0.7071; }
    if index == 6 { return 0.0; }
    return 0.7071;
}

fn direction_y(index) {
    if index == 0 { return 0.0; }
    if index == 1 { return 0.7071; }
    if index == 2 { return 1.0; }
    if index == 3 { return 0.7071; }
    if index == 4 { return 0.0; }
    if index == 5 { return -0.7071; }
    if index == 6 { return -1.0; }
    return -0.7071;
}

fn configure_asteroid(world_api, asteroid, x, y, radius, vertices, speed, direction, seed) {
    world_api.entities.set_position_2d(asteroid, x, y);
    world_api.motion.set_velocity(
        asteroid,
        direction_x(direction) * speed,
        direction_y(direction) * speed,
    );
    world_api.vector.set_radial_jitter_polygon(asteroid, vertices, radius, 0.24, seed);
    world_api.physics.set_circle_radius(asteroid, radius);
    world_api.entities.set_property_string(asteroid, "asteroid_size", asteroid_size_for_radius(radius));
    world_api.entities.set_property_int(asteroid, "score_value", score_for_radius(radius));
    world_api.entities.set_property_float(asteroid, "radius", radius);
    world_api.entities.set_property_float(asteroid, "speed", speed);
}

fn start_wave(world_api, current_wave) {
    world_api.pools.release_all(asteroid_pool());
    let count = wave_asteroid_count(world_api, current_wave);
    let i = 0;

    while i < count {
        let asteroid = world_api.pools.acquire(asteroid_pool());
        if asteroid == "" { return; }

        let radius = rand_range(world_api, wave_radius_min(current_wave), wave_radius_max());
        let vertices = rand_int(world_api, 8, 14);
        let speed = rand_range(world_api, wave_speed_min(world_api, current_wave), wave_speed_max(world_api, current_wave));
        let direction = rand_int(world_api, 0, 7);
        let pos = random_spawn_position_away_from_center(world_api);
        let seed = rng_seed(world_api) + i;

        configure_asteroid(
            world_api,
            asteroid,
            pos.x,
            pos.y,
            radius,
            vertices,
            speed,
            direction,
            seed,
        );

        i = i + 1;
    }

    set_wave(world_api, current_wave);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    set_timed_status(world_api, "WAVE " + pad_two(current_wave), status_flash_seconds());
}

fn enter_wave_clear(world_api) {
    set_mode(world_api, "wave_clear");
    world_api.particles.set_active(thrust_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(thrust_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
    set_score(world_api, score(world_api) + wave(world_api) * 100);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    set_status(world_api, "WAVE CLEAR");
    world_api.timers.start("wave-clear", wave_clear_delay());
    world_api.audio.play("wave-start");
}

fn update_wave_clear(world_api) {
    if world_api.timers.ready("wave-clear") {
        let next_wave = wave(world_api) + 1;
        set_mode(world_api, "playing");
        start_wave(world_api, next_wave);
        world_api.audio.play("wave-start");
    }
}

fn enter_game_over(world_api) {
    set_mode(world_api, "game_over");
    world_api.pools.release_all(bullet_pool());
    world_api.pools.release_all(asteroid_pool());
    world_api.entities.hide(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.disable(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.set_collision_enabled(ship_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_active(thrust_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(thrust_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.entities.hide(shield_name());
    maybe_insert_highscore(world_api, score(world_api));
    sync_hud(world_api);
    world_api.entities.hide(hud_name());
    world_api.ui.hide(ui_root(hud_name()));
    world_api.entities.show(game_over_name());
    world_api.ui.show(ui_root(game_over_name()));
    set_status(world_api, "");
    world_api.audio.play("game-over");
}

fn update_game_over(world_api) {}

fn update_shield(world_api) {
    if world_api.timers.active("ship-shield") {
        world_api.entities.show(shield_name());
    } else {
        world_api.entities.hide(shield_name());
    }
}

fn update_player_input(world_api, dt) {
    let thrust_axis = input::axis(world_api, "ship.thrust");
    update_speed_starfield(world_api, thrust_axis, dt);
}

fn update_playing(world_api, dt) {
    if input::pressed(world_api, "game.restart") {
        start_new_game(world_api);
        return;
    }

    update_player_input(world_api, dt);
    update_shield(world_api);
    update_status(world_api);
}

fn spawn_split_fragment(world_api, x, y, radius, speed, direction, seed) {
    let fragment = world_api.pools.acquire(asteroid_pool());
    if fragment == "" { return false; }

    let offset = radius * 0.55;
    configure_asteroid(
        world_api,
        fragment,
        x + direction_x(direction) * offset,
        y + direction_y(direction) * offset,
        radius,
        rand_int(world_api, 8, 12),
        speed,
        direction,
        seed,
    );
    return true;
}

fn split_asteroid(world_api, asteroid, radius, x, y) {
    let child_radius = split_radius(radius);
    if child_radius <= 0.0 { return 0; }

    let parent_speed = world_api.entities.property_float(asteroid, "speed");
    let speed = fragment_speed(world_api, parent_speed);
    let direction = rand_int(world_api, 0, 7);
    let opposite = (direction + 4) % 8;
    let seed = rng_seed(world_api);
    let spawned = 0;

    if spawn_split_fragment(world_api, x, y, child_radius, speed, direction, seed + 17) {
        spawned = spawned + 1;
    }
    if spawn_split_fragment(world_api, x, y, child_radius, speed, opposite, seed + 31) {
        spawned = spawned + 1;
    }

    return spawned;
}

fn handle_bullet_hit(world_api, bullet, asteroid) {
    let pos = world_api.entities.position_2d(asteroid);
    let radius = world_api.entities.property_float(asteroid, "radius");
    let score_value = world_api.entities.property_int(asteroid, "score_value");

    world_api.pools.release(bullet_pool(), bullet);
    set_score(world_api, score(world_api) + score_value);
    world_api.pools.release(asteroid_pool(), asteroid);
    split_asteroid(world_api, asteroid, radius, pos.x, pos.y);
    world_api.audio.play("asteroid-hit");
    sync_hud(world_api);

    if world_api.pools.active_count(asteroid_pool()) <= 0 {
        enter_wave_clear(world_api);
    }
}

fn handle_ship_hit(world_api) {
    if mode(world_api) != "playing" { return; }
    if world_api.timers.active("ship-shield") { return; }

    set_lives(world_api, lives(world_api) - 1);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    world_api.pools.release_all(bullet_pool());

    if lives(world_api) <= 0 {
        enter_game_over(world_api);
        return;
    }

    set_timed_status(world_api, "READY", status_flash_seconds());
    reset_player(world_api);
    world_api.audio.play("respawn-shield");
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    world.timers.reset_scene();

    let clips = [
        "shot",
        "asteroid-hit",
        "game-over",
        "wave-start",
        "respawn-shield",
    ];
    let clip_index = 0;
    while clip_index < clips.len() {
        world.audio.preload(clips[clip_index]);
        clip_index = clip_index + 1;
    }

    start_new_game(world);
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "asteroids.bullet_hit_asteroid" && payload.len() >= 2 {
        if mode(world) == "playing" {
            handle_bullet_hit(world, payload[0], payload[1]);
        }
        return;
    }

    if topic == "asteroids.ship_hit_asteroid" {
        handle_ship_hit(world);
        return;
    }
}

fn update(dt) {
    let current_mode = mode(world);

    if current_mode == "playing" {
        update_playing(world, dt);
        return;
    }

    if current_mode == "wave_clear" {
        update_wave_clear(world);
        return;
    }

    if current_mode == "game_over" {
        update_game_over(world);
        return;
    }

}

fn pad_score(value) {
    if value < 10 { return "00000" + value; }
    if value < 100 { return "0000" + value; }
    if value < 1000 { return "000" + value; }
    if value < 10000 { return "00" + value; }
    if value < 100000 { return "0" + value; }
    return "" + value;
}

fn highscore(world_api, index) {
    let value = world_api.session.get_int("asteroids.highscore." + index);
    if value > 0 { return value; }
    if index == 1 { return 10000; }
    if index == 2 { return 7500; }
    if index == 3 { return 5000; }
    if index == 4 { return 2500; }
    return 1000;
}

fn sync_highscores(world_api) {
    let text = "AAA " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 1))
        + "\nBBB " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 2))
        + "\nCCC " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 3))
        + "\nDDD " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 4))
        + "\nEEE " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 5));
    world_api.state.set_string("highscores_text", text);
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    sync_highscores(world);
}

fn update(dt) {}

fn menu_label(world_api, index, label) {
    return label;
}

fn seed_highscores(world_api) {
    if world_api.session.get_int("asteroids.highscore.1") <= 0 {
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.1", 10000);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.2", 7500);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.3", 5000);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.4", 2500);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.5", 1000);
    }
}

fn sync_menu(world_api) {
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_start_text", menu_label(world_api, 0, "START"));
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_options_text", menu_label(world_api, 1, "OPTIONS"));
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_highscores_text", menu_label(world_api, 2, "HIGHSCORES"));
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_quit_text", menu_label(world_api, 3, "QUIT"));
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    world.state.set_int("menu_index", 0);
    world.state.set_string("status_text", "");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.0", "#FFFFFFFF");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.1", "#9A9A9AFF");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.2", "#9A9A9AFF");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.3", "#9A9A9AFF");
    seed_highscores(world);
    world.audio.preload("menu-move");
    world.audio.preload("menu-select");
    sync_menu(world);
}

fn update(dt) {}

fn low_mode(world_api) { world_api.session.get_bool("asteroids.low_mode") }

fn sync_options(world_api) {
    let low = "LOW: OFF";
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        low = "LOW: ON";
    }
    world_api.state.set_string("option_low_text", low);
    world_api.state.set_string("option_back_text", "BACK");
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    world.state.set_int("option_index", 0);
    world.state.set_string("option_color.0", "#FFFFFFFF");
    world.state.set_string("option_color.1", "#9A9A9AFF");
    world.audio.preload("menu-move");
    world.audio.preload("menu-select");
    sync_options(world);
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "asteroids.options.toggle-low" {
        world.session.set_bool("asteroids.low_mode", !low_mode(world));
        sync_options(world);
    }
}

fn update(dt) {}
